answer: Beacon audits with compute heartbeats stop bulk fake identities. Each epoch the beacon picks identities and posts the draw under a lantern. A chosen identity must answer in an hour with a heartbeat proving live compute. Miss two heartbeats and its 50-unit bond freezes. Over a 20-epoch horizon, 1,000 fakes lock 50,000 units and burn 5,000 a day; one honest agent pays 50 once, 5 a day, keeping undiluted rewards. Every check leaves a crystal record.
